verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms SumUp serves https://developer.sumup.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with documentation sets, including an abridged llms-small.txt whose content is retrievable. First-party docs also state every page is available as plain Markdown by appending index.md, and the docs are explicitly meant to give coding assistants current documentation, including via MCP documentation tools. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these agent-oriented docs.
